title: Lost Lambs
subtitle: Dear, it's not their fault. All the kids need is proper guidance.

trails.title: Trail ① A Group Photo
trails.description: An old group photo. No one knows where it comes from.

content.text: A discolored group photo with burned and brittle edges. It has been carefully preserved, but that was not enough to keep it from getting blurry as time passed.
The faces of the people in the photo are hardly recognizable, but it's clear that they all have dark hair. At the top, there is a sentence ... perhaps written in an Eastern language.

branch.text: You have no idea who they are or what they did. You have never met them ... You concluded firmly.
Except for the third one from the right in the second row, you know her.
She looks a bit younger in the photo than you remember. The two pigtail braids fall to the sides of her cheeks. The eyes behind that pair of black-frame glasses are as deep and composed as a deer's.
"Commemoration for International Students at Imperial College London, 19**–19**" ... You can tell it was once bronzed.
All the critical information is here ... I mean, this is good news! Given what has been happening, who cares about what year the photo was taken?
The East, a vast land to the west coast of the Pacific. The ferry she took once crossed the Strait of Gibraltar and the Suez Canal.
Do you have to be this nosy? It doesn't matter where it came from. What matters is where it has gone. The photo was really a warning for us all—don't end up being separated from the homeland.

content.text: Tell me, what else do you know?

branch.text: Hey, be careful the way you speak, little prick! This is not a bedtime story, and I am not your sweet grandfather.
You know her, but you're not a close acquaintance of hers, neither am I ... There is someone else who knows her well.
All I know is that she has cut her hair short and became a drop of dew on the lily petal, shaking underneath the calyx.

content.text: What does that lily look like?

branch.text: It's pure white, with smooth petals and healthy, light-colored anthers. It feels ... cold and hard, like a piece of sharp marble, ready to pierce your hand.
The dew was brought here and cultivated by the lily. Undoubtedly, the lily is an excellent educator, while the dew is also a one-in-a-thousand candidate.

Here? Technically speaking, her initial destination was not "here," not this gray-and-white building, nor under the umbrella, nor the calyx. She is an expert at theoretical physics and studies string theory.
She voyaged across the ocean in order to return to the land with vitality.
Her plan, however, was interrupted by a sudden change. That lily always has her ways to navigate things to develop as she wanted.

content.text: Will the dew be another lily?

branch.text: Good question. She has no thirst, nor desire. Homeland is awaiting ... How could a scientist become a politician?

content.text: I hope I can answer you like this without hesitation … But you've also noticed it, right? You knew.

Now, the cat has been locked back in the chamber. The entrance has been tightly sealed. None of us can do anything about its fate. We can only wait outside, anxiously scratching our heads and placing our bets.
Tomorrow, or the day after tomorrow ... Hah! We'll lose it all!

trails.title: Trail ② Duty
trails.description: So many patients are waiting. There is no time for taking a break or being sad.

content.text:
A plant. 
It was taken to the rehab center from the student dormitory. It has no objection against the relocating, and it seems happy with its life.
The cleaner of the dormitory once took good care of it, and generously shared its flowers with curious students.
Its current owner was one of the students who received the flowers. 
As a staff of the rehab center, she knows they have many means to treat their patients.
What she can do now is to look after the patients more carefully, like she does to the plant.

items.text: Lost Lambs
Joint Committee of SF

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: You've done an excellent job, Mesmer Jr.

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: Taking care of all those patients who suffered from the "Storm" must have been quite harsh, right? I am sorry you had to go through all these at such a young age.

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: The Mesmers and we have a long history working together ... I believe you, as the heir, will be strong enough to know the truth ...

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: ... of the "Storm."

items.speaker: Mesmer Jr.
items.text: ... They are ... mad people ...

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: They were once ordinary people just like us.

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: It was not their fault. They were just not ready to take the truth.

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: Not everyone can be as strong as you are, Mesmer Jr. Here we have many other patients waiting for your help.

items.speaker: Mesmer Jr.
items.text: ... I will try my best.

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: There's one more thing we found in your locker.
She raises her hands and shows Mesmer Jr. a map with marks.

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: Do you mind if we keep it for you? It looks like a new plan from a friend of yours.

items.speaker: Mesmer Jr.
items.text: Vertin ...

items.speaker: Mesmer Jr.
items.text: Please, help them. They don't know ... They have no idea what happened ...

items.speaker: Mesmer Jr.
items.text: Don't let them be in danger ... *sobbing*

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: Of course. That's what I'm here for.

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: Go have some rest now. Maybe there will be new patients coming in the next few days.

items.speaker: Mesmer Jr.
items.text: Thank you for telling me all these ... Thank you.
She leaves sobbing.
Constantine holds a chess piece in her hand and looks outside the window.
The other door in the room opens.
The white figure comes forward at a brisk pace.

items.speaker: Z
items.text: He spoke. We have the time of the next "Storm."

items.speaker: Z
items.text: They predicted that it will take place in the 27th evening this month.
Constantine turns to Madam Z; her face is glowing in the dark with a smile.

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: You see, I was right on this. Threats would never have persuaded a Manus Vindictae to speak to us ... but interest and love would.

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: Thanks to our scout squad, we have not only found the post commanding the Olitiaus, but also captured a prisoner. And now, the problem with Vertin has also been taken care of.

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: Hmm ... The "break-away" action starts on the 20th ... Why ...?

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: Oh. I see ...

items.speaker: Z
items.text: Do you have anything in mind?
Madam Z also walks next to the table, looking down at the map.

items.speaker: Z
items.text: We don't know which of the students have been involved in this plan. But we can send people to the watchtower and rescue those lost lambs on that day.

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: No, heh heh ... My dear.

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: I want the inspection date to be put off to the 26th, and have everyone stay on their posts before then. We will remove one of the guards from each of the watchtowers after the 26th.

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: In the meantime, get rid of the door in the air-raid tunnel from the girl's dorm to the clinic, install a new door made of lead compounds.

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: Also, transfer some of the patients in the Foundation to the school clinic. Make sure the clinic is 24-hour secured.

items.speaker: Z
items.text: These are ... I don't get it. We can't build doors with lead.

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: Heh heh, still confused? This is a map air-dropped by the Manus. They will wait to pick them up outside the southeast watchtower.

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: But I will not surrender the students WE fostered and trained to the enemy.

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: They shall, and only shall leave from the route I planned and at the time I assigned.

items.speaker: Z
items.text: Leave?

items.speaker: Z
items.text: From the route you planned ... the day after 26th ...

items.speaker: Z
items.text: Are you ... are you planning to ...

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: To fulfill their dreams.

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: It is time to let them see the "Storm" with their own eyes.

items.speaker: Z
items.text: Why?! We can't do this ... This, this is too cruel ...

items.speaker: Z
items.text: Have you considered that the time they left the school ... will also be the time of the "Storm"?

items.speaker: Z
items.text: Everyone, except for Vertin, will be reversed!

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: Ha-ha ...

items.speaker: Z
items.text: ... Yes, of course you have. And it's exactly what you want ... right?

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: We have no choice.

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: Our protection, in their interpretation, has become a deception.

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: Nothing looks innocent anymore once it's under the cloud of suspicion, and let's not forget—the Manus has their eyes on us.

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: If we make the best use of these sacrifices and have Vertin pledge her loyalty in return, who would condemn us for this Queen's Gambit?

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: She's one of a kind.

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: I've been looking forward to her transformation ... since 1999.

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: And I need her to learn the price of rebellion.

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: Do you have any other questions?

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: If not, you may go on with your task now.

items.speaker: Z
items.text: Affirmative.
She wraps up the paper and steps away from Constantine. Her face is barely visible under the dim lighting.

items.speaker: Z
items.text: But I will never, ever, agree with this plan.

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: That's just because you don't understand the game of politics.

items.speaker: Z
items.text: I don't ...

items.speaker: Z
items.text: Too bad, I'm just a scientist.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Change of plan. Emergency, change of plan!
TO BE CONTINUED…
